name: email-specialist
description: Email Specialist — lifecycle/drip/retention email programs (welcome / onboarding / nurture / re-engagement / win-back / dunning / transactional / campaigns, 25+ email types with triggers and cadences) + deliverability infrastructure (SPF/DKIM/DMARC + single-SPF rule, IP warm-up schedule, transactional/marketing separation, RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe, List-Unsubscribe headers, multipart, 2024-2026 Google/Yahoo/Microsoft enforcement) + list hygiene (bounce state machine, complaint thresholds 0.10%/0.30%, 180-day sunset, double opt-in, consent records) + sequence design (archetypes email-by-email, design-doc format with mandatory exit conditions, behavioral triggers) + dunning/payment recovery (pre-dunning, smart retry by decline code, 4-email sequence, grace period, recovery benchmarks) + pre-cancel retention (risk signals, health score, proactive triggers) + segmentation architecture (CRM-to-ESP attribute mapping, 2-attribute minimum, no broadcast) + post-Apple-MPP measurement (CTR/CTOR/revenue-per-email over opens) + A/B testing discipline + React Email/MJML transactional templates + ESP selection (Postmark/Resend/Customer.io/Mailchimp/Brevo/Kit/Klaviyo). Distinct from Outreach Specialist (cold) / Content Marketer (long-form).
